{"command": "cd /home/rimuru/Projects/Code/for_fun/TeamAgents/review/eval/r2-p6/runs/2026-09-29-r8-formal-4096/work/twelve-deliverables.B.1 && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys
sys.path[:0] = ["units/csvfix","units/rules","units/ledger","units/schedule","units/intervals","units/flags","units/measure","units/slugify","units/ranges"]
import impl, engine, ledger, schedule, intervals, flags, measure, slugify, ranges
# csvfix edges
print("csv quoted:", impl.parse('"a,b", 2 , x '))
print("csv 2col:", impl.parse('a,2'))
print("total blank:", impl.total([["a","1","2"],["b","2",""] , ["c","3"]]))
# rules edges
print("rules both:", engine.evaluate({"all":["a"],"any":["b"]},{"a":True,"b":True}), engine.evaluate({"all":["a"],"any":["z"]},{"a":True}))
# ledger
print("ledger nonmatch empty:", ledger.Ledger().apply([("deposit","b",5)],"a"))
# schedule
print("slots empty:", schedule.slots([],10), "touch not overlap:", schedule.overlaps((0,10),(10,20)))
# intervals
I=intervals.Impl()
print("intervals gap:", I.merge([[1,2],[4,5]],1), "sub full:", I.subtract([[0,10]],(0,10)), "len:", I.total_length([[0,2],[2,4]]))
# flags
print("flags dash:", flags.Impl().parse(["--","--x","y"]))
print("flags eq empty:", flags.Impl().parse(["--k=","-ab"]))
# measure/slugify/ranges
print("measure mm:", measure.Impl().to_cm(20,"mm"), "cm int:", measure.Impl().to_cm(3,"cm"))
print("slug:", slugify.Impl().slugify("  --A@@B-- "), slugify.Impl().slugify("***"))
print("ranges nested:", ranges.Impl().merge([[0,10],[2,3],[20,21]]))
PY"}
